title: Sindhu, Shetty Advance at Worlds; Lakshya Sen Suffers Shock Exit
indian_angle: While PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty secured comfortable wins, the unexpected early departure of Lakshya Sen is a significant setback for India at the World Championships.
summary: PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty progressed easily at the BWF World Championships, but Lakshya Sen was eliminated in a surprising second-round defeat to USA's Garret Tan.

title: Lakshya Sen: "Constantly Playing Catch-Up" in World Championships Exit
indian_angle: Lakshya Sen's candid reflection provides insight into the challenges faced by Indian players at the highest level after his unexpected World Championships defeat.
summary: Following his early exit from the BWF World Championships, Lakshya Sen admitted to being "constantly playing catch-up" during his disappointing match.

title: Ayush Shetty Stuns Defending Champion Shi Yu Qi at Worlds
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty created a massive upset by eliminating the reigning world champion, boosting India's hopes.
summary: Ayush Shetty delivered a stunning upset by defeating defending world champion Shi Yu Qi 21-14, 13-21, 21-19 in a thrilling match at the BWF World Championships.

title: Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's young talent for upcoming continental junior championships.
summary: The Indian junior badminton team is currently undergoing a coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati in preparation for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India is introducing a new scoring system for U13, U15, and U17 domestic events, impacting the development of future Indian stars.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
